prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 主流旗舰手机屏幕与价格参数 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "型号" spans 1 col × 2 row; "屏幕" spans 2 col × 1 row; "价格" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "型号" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 155px
  col 2: header "屏幕 › 尺寸" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 66px
  col 3: header "屏幕 › 技术" · longest unbreakable word 78px · one-line width 486px
  col 4: header "价格" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 72px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较主流旗舰手机的屏幕尺寸、屏幕技术与价格参数。","reading":"读者先按型号定位一行，再横向查看该机参数，也会沿尺寸、技术或价格列纵向比较；屏幕技术描述较长，是主要的换行来源。","groups":["尺寸和技术同属屏幕参数，应在共同表头下保持清晰的层级；两列的信息密度不同，无须等宽。","型号用于识别行，价格是独立的比较指标；两者应与同一行的屏幕参数容易对应。"],"keep_intact":["手机型号中的品牌和型号标识尽量完整，尤其是数字及 Pro、Ultra 等后缀。","屏幕尺寸中的数字和单位、价格中的数字及货币单位应尽量保持完整。","屏幕技术中的 AMOLED、OLED、LTPO、120Hz 等标识应保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["屏幕技术描述可在标点、空格或自然词组边界处换行；较高的技术单元格也可容纳同一行型号或价格的换行。","较长的手机型号可在品牌与型号之间换行，避免拆开型号标识。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [110, 56, 122, 71] · table 360×942px · row heights [36, 36, 153, 129, 129, 153, 153, 153] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [90, 55, 155, 59] · table 360×733px · row heights [36, 36, 106, 106, 106, 129, 106, 106] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [100, 55, 111, 93] · table 360×1012px · row heights [36, 36, 176, 129, 129, 153, 176, 176] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"型号列较宽，品牌和型号大多能以一两行辨认；屏幕分组表头清楚，价格也容易沿列比较。","problems":"技术描述过于零碎，多行被拉得很高；尺寸和价格均需换行，行内留白因此显得不均衡。","cause":"技术列仅122px，可用文本宽度约101px；尺寸列56px、价格列71px，分别不足以容纳完整的尺寸和价格。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"技术列较宽，描述的语义片段更连贯，行高和整表长度明显改善；屏幕分组及横向比较关系清晰。","problems":"型号列偏窄，OPPO 和三星型号被拆成三行，型号定位不够利落；尺寸与价格仍分两行，价格列也较拥挤。","cause":"型号列90px，可用文本宽度约69px；尺寸列55px和价格列59px分别不能容纳完整的数字与单位。155px的技术列取得了较好的可读性，但占用了识别列和指标列的空间。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"价格完整地显示在一行，纵向比较方便；型号列比r0B宽，部分型号的断行较自然。","problems":"技术描述换行过密，造成最高的行和最长的表；价格列相对宽裕，与拥挤的技术列形成明显失衡。尺寸仍分两行。","cause":"价格列93px足以容纳完整价格，但技术列仅111px，可用文本宽度约90px；尺寸列55px仍不足以容纳完整尺寸。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-tech","widths":[100,55,145,59],"change":"以r0B为基础，将10px从技术列移至型号列，改善品牌与型号的分行，同时保留较宽的技术列；尺寸和价格沿用两行，以控制整体行高。"},{"name":"intact-price","widths":[95,55,120,89],"change":"为价格留出完整单行所需宽度，型号列略宽于r0B；技术列比r0C宽，检验完整价格与技术描述可读性之间的折中。"},{"name":"intact-size","widths":[90,87,133,49],"change":"将尺寸列加宽至可容纳完整尺寸，便于纵向比较；技术列仍保留较多空间，价格按数字与单位分行，检验另一种指标优先级。"}]}
